sources.visual_reading: A grey SUV is nose-in to the shopfront. The tall white SUV occupies its far flank. On the near flank, a broad unobstructed painted bay lies between the next two lines and opens to the paved aisle. The request does not establish a full parking footprint.

The large white van occupies the near right margin. Its rear fills the side of the crop, with the bonnet obscuring ground aft of it. The raised pedestrian kerb and travel-lane side do not verify an open rear pull-in.
